A_ground_truth_provenance.details: Identity/camera/scene labels come from the sealed RGBNT201 protocol; saved distance metadata must equal that protocol. The local protocol hash matches the original seal; all 836 diagnosis query identities match protocol order. Positive means same identity and different camera; every different identity is a legal negative, including same-camera negatives. Model-derived correction means are descriptive decomposition terms, not ground truth. Dataset images and original inventory were not independently inspected.

B_score_normalization.details: Standard cosine norm products and fixed query-positive averaging only; no benchmark score divided by a model-specific maximum or mean. Raw signed and absolute component summaries are reported. Final source uses saved raw-fused norm products for every algebraic term. Corrections are split by test-sample means only for accounting, without creating a centered retrieval representation.

C_result_existence.details: Both prior DIAGNOSIS JSON files exist, declare COMPLETE/E8, match the provided INPUT_SEAL hash and checkpoint hashes, and contain all 836 AP/rank entries. Prior mAP/rank scalar receipts agree with those saved arrays. The new cosine result was not read or accepted during this source stage. Six raw feature/distance tensors are referenced by sealed hashes but were not loaded or independently verified by this auditor.

D_called_and_dead_code.details: main calls analyze for both wrapper rows; analyze calls decompose and every reported term flows into pair and equal-query summaries. describe is used throughout. No newly introduced metric function is dead. The analysis imports no project model or training module, makes no model forward/optimizer call, does not save tensors, and copies prior ranks/metrics. argmin selects one saved-G hard negative; this is not a full retrieval ranking or a new official performance evaluation. Literal zero counters are source declarations, not independently instrumented runtime evidence.

E_scope.details: Scope is explicitly two fixed RGBNT201 seed42 arms at selected epoch 8, 836 queries, 836 gallery records, 30 identities and cameras 0/1. Query/gallery records are exactly equal, not merely partially overlapping. Pair summaries and equal-query summaries have different weights; equal-query does not mean equal-identity weighting. Repairs/new errors are tiny groups and selected using observed saved outcomes. No multi-seed robustness, multi-dataset completion, generalization, significance, or causal attribution follows.

F_evaluation_type.details: Real dataset labels define legal pairs; the new measurements are post-selection algebraic descriptive probes of saved model representations, not a new retrieval benchmark or a causal intervention. The original exposure sensitivity is model-derived and explicitly labeled as a proxy in its source, but it is not being used as ground truth in this probe.

mathematical_review.shape: Eight tensors must each be finite with shape (836,1536); resulting pair matrices are (836,836). Metadata must match the protocol order.
mathematical_review.identity: Let Iq=Gq+a*Cq, Ig=Gg+a*Cg, A=||Hq||||Hg||, N=||Gq||||Gg|| and C=d+r on each split. The first six terms sum to Iq·Ig/A-Gq·Gg/N. The seventh is (Hq·Hg-Iq·Ig)/A. Their sum is cos(Hq,Hg)-cos(Gq,Gg). Subtracting the same fixed negative and averaging positives preserves additivity.
mathematical_review.denominator_semantics: A is the observed saved raw_fused norm product shared by all six terms; si is Iq·Ig/A, not separately normalized cosine(Iq,Ig).
mathematical_review.limits: These are declared acceptance thresholds, not observed outcomes at source stage. Exact algebraic accounting refers to saved-raw cosine; equality with saved deployed F and saved FP32 distance arrays is tolerance-qualified.

sampling_review.negative_definition: all different identities, with no camera restriction
sampling_review.fixed_negative: One minimum entry from the saved global distance row after masking all same-identity entries. Ties select the lowest gallery index. No F-based reselection.
sampling_review.common_mean_weights: Per-vector sample mean of each split; not identity-balanced.
sampling_review.pair_summary_weights: Each legal pair, or each positive-versus-fixed-negative pair, receives one weight.
sampling_review.query_summary_weights: Average each query's legal positives, then weight queries equally inside each saved rank group.
sampling_review.causal_limit: Test-derived grouping, shared denominator and cancellation make contributions convention-dependent. Removing a term would change other terms and the denominator; displayed terms are not intervention effects.
